title: Sensing Low-Frequency Field with Rydberg Atoms via Quantum Weak Measurement
summary: Recently, Rydberg atom has emerged as an attractive choice to realize quantum sensing of low-frequency electric field. The progress so far has mostly utilized the intensity and phase changes in probe laser and the corresponding detection mechanism still remains classical. Nevertheless, external field acting on the Rydberg state can induce the polarization variation of probe laser in the Rydberg electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT) system embedded in realistic multi-state atoms.
